Pending the present Writ Petition, the learned counsel for the petitioner filed the Writ Miscellaneous Petition in W.M.P.No.29282 of 2023 praying to implead the proposed respondents therein as party respondents/fourth and fifth respondents in the above Writ Petition.

When the said W.M.P was taken up for hearing on 16.10.2023, this Court ordered notice to the proposed respondents through Court and privately returnable by 08.11.2023 and this Court also directed the learned counsel for the petitioner to file an Affidavit of Service on or before 08.11.2023 and the matter was directed to be listed on 09.11.2023.

Today (09.11.2023), when the matter is taken up for hearing, there was no representation for the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis petitioner and also cause list reflects that either batta or Affidavit of Service has not yet been filed.
The petitioner has not complied with the order of this Court dated 16.10.2023 and hence, this Writ Miscellaneous Petition is dismissed.
From this, it is clear that the petitioner is not interested in prosecuting either W.M.P or the main Writ Petition.
Hence, Writ Petition also shall stand dismissed for non-prosecution.
There shall be no order as to costs.
